sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [F]We know not [Bb]the hour of the Master’s appearing;
[Bb]Yet signs all foretell that the moment is nearing
[F]When He shall return ’tis [F7]the promise most cheering

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Bb]He will come, let [F]us watch and be ready;
[F]He will come [F7]in the clouds of His Father's
[Eb/Bb]bright glory but we [Bb]know not the hour.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [F]There's light for [Bb]the wise who are seeking salvation;
[Bb]There's truth in the book of the Lord's revelation;

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [F]We'll watch and [Bb]we'll pray, with our lamps trimmed and burning;
[Bb]We'll work and we'll wait till the Master's returning;
